---
title: "HPC Demand Analysis and Forecast"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(readxl)

demand_allocation <- read_excel(
  here(
    "assets",
    "data",
    "data clean",
    "demand_allocation_data.xlsx"
  )
)
```

```{r}
demand_allocation <- demand_allocation |>
  mutate(
    standardised_requested_ksu = case_when(
      unit == "kSU" ~ requested_compute,

      unit == "mixed: million hours requested / kSU allocated" ~
        requested_compute * 1e6 / 500,

      unit %in% c(
        "million hours",
        "million core hours",
        "million CPU-hours"
      ) ~ requested_compute * 1e6 / 500,

      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    standardised_allocated_ksu = case_when(
      unit == "kSU" ~ allocated_compute,

      unit == "mixed: million hours requested / kSU allocated" ~
        allocated_compute,

      unit %in% c(
        "million hours",
        "million core hours",
        "million CPU-hours"
      ) ~ allocated_compute * 1e6 / 500,

      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
```

```{r}
demand_allocation <- demand_allocation |>
  mutate(
    conversion_status = case_when(
      unit == "kSU" ~ "Reported in kSU",
      TRUE ~ "Converted using interim 500 core-hours per kSU assumption"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
demand_allocation |>
  select(
    source_period,
    unit,
    requested_compute,
    allocated_compute,
    standardised_requested_ksu,
    standardised_allocated_ksu
  )
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

demand_allocation |>
  ggplot(aes(x = source_period)) +

  # Requested
  geom_line(
    aes(
      y = standardised_requested_ksu,
      colour = "Requested compute",
      group = 1
    ),
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +

  geom_point(
    aes(
      y = standardised_requested_ksu,
      colour = "Requested compute"
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +

  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = standardised_requested_ksu,
      label = label_number(
        scale_cut = cut_short_scale(),
        accuracy = 0.01
      )(standardised_requested_ksu)
    ),
    vjust = -0.8,
    size = 3.2,
    colour = "#2166AC"
  ) +

  # Allocated
  geom_line(
    aes(
      y = standardised_allocated_ksu,
      colour = "Allocated compute",
      group = 1
    ),
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +

  geom_point(
    aes(
      y = standardised_allocated_ksu,
      colour = "Allocated compute"
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +

  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = standardised_allocated_ksu,
      label = label_number(
        scale_cut = cut_short_scale(),
        accuracy = 0.01
      )(standardised_allocated_ksu)
    ),
    vjust = 1.7,
    size = 3.2,
    colour = "#2B8C4B"
  ) +

  # Separation between converted and reported kSU
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 6.5,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey55",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 3.5,
    y = 2300000,
    label = "Converted historical values",
    size = 3.5,
    colour = "grey35"
  ) +

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 10,
    y = 2300000,
    label = "Reported in kSU",
    size = 3.5,
    colour = "grey35"
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_number(
      scale = 1e-6,
      suffix = "M",
      accuracy = 0.1
    ),
    limits = c(0, 2500000),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Requested compute" = "#2166AC",
      "Allocated compute" = "#2B8C4B"
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Requested vs Allocated Compute, 2013/14–2025/26",
    subtitle = "Standardised to kSU (historical hour-based values use an interim conversion assumption)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Compute (million kSU)",
    colour = NULL,
    caption = "Historical conversions use an interim 500 core-hours per kSU assumption pending confirmation from NCI and Pawsey."
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 17
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 11,
      colour = "grey30"
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 9,
      colour = "grey40",
      hjust = 0
    )
  )
```

```{r}
for_allocation <- read_excel(
  here(
    "assets",
    "data",
    "data clean",
    "yearly_field_of_research_data.xlsx"
  )
)

```

```{r}
for_allocation <- for_allocation |>
  mutate(
    standardised_demand_ksu = case_when(
      compute_unit == "kSU" ~ demand_compute_proxy,

      compute_unit == "mixed: million hours requested / kSU allocated" ~
        demand_compute_proxy * 1e6 / 500,

      compute_unit %in% c(
        "million hours",
        "million core hours",
        "million CPU-hours"
      ) ~ demand_compute_proxy * 1e6 / 500,

      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    standardised_allocated_ksu = case_when(
      compute_unit == "kSU" ~ allocated_compute_for,

      compute_unit == "mixed: million hours requested / kSU allocated" ~
        allocated_compute_for,

      compute_unit %in% c(
        "million hours",
        "million core hours",
        "million CPU-hours"
      ) ~ allocated_compute_for * 1e6 / 500,

      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
```

```{r}
for_allocation |>
  filter(
    is.na(standardised_demand_ksu) |
      is.na(standardised_allocated_ksu)
  ) |>
  distinct(source_period, compute_unit)
```

```{r}
for_allocation |>
  group_by(source_period) |>
  summarise(
    total_demand_ksu = sum(standardised_demand_ksu, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_allocated_ksu = sum(standardised_allocated_ksu, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
for_allocation |>
  group_by(source_period, for_standard_2020) |>
  summarise(
    allocated_ksu = sum(standardised_allocated_ksu, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
major_fields <- c(
  "Physical sciences",
  "Chemical sciences",
  "Biological sciences",
  "Information and computing sciences",
  "Engineering",
  "Mathematical sciences"
)

for_major <- for_allocation |>
  filter(for_standard_2020 %in% major_fields) |>
  group_by(source_period, for_standard_2020) |>
  summarise(
    allocated_ksu = sum(standardised_allocated_ksu, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(
  for_major,
  aes(
    x = source_period,
    y = allocated_ksu,
    colour = for_standard_2020,
    linetype = for_standard_2020,
    group = for_standard_2020
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +

  scale_colour_viridis_d(
    option = "D",
    end = 0.9
  ) +

  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c(
      "solid",
      "dashed",
      "dotted",
      "dotdash",
      "longdash",
      "twodash"
    )
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(
      scale = 1e-3,
      suffix = "K"
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "HPC Allocation Trends for Major Fields of Research",
    subtitle = "Standardised allocated compute, 2013/14–2025/26",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Allocated compute (kSU)",
    colour = "Field of Research",
    linetype = "Field of Research"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 17
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

```


```{r}
for_stacked <- for_allocation |>
  group_by(source_period, for_standard_2020) |>
  summarise(
    allocated_ksu = sum(standardised_allocated_ksu, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(source_period) |>
  arrange(allocated_ksu, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    stack_order = row_number()
  ) |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  for_stacked,
  aes(
    x = source_period,
    y = allocated_ksu,
    fill = for_standard_2020,
    order = stack_order
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.8,
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +

  scale_fill_viridis_d(
    option = "D",
    end = 0.9
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(
      scale = 1e-3,
      suffix = "K",
      accuracy = 1
    ),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Allocated HPC Compute by Field of Research, 2013/14–2025/26",
    subtitle = "Fields are ordered from smallest to largest allocation within each year",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Allocated compute (kSU)",
    fill = "Field of Research",
    caption = "Historical hour-based values use an interim 500 core-hours per kSU conversion assumption."
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 17
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 11,
      colour = "grey30"
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 9,
      colour = "grey40",
      hjust = 0
    )
  )
```

```{r}
for_stacked <- for_allocation |>
  group_by(source_period, for_standard_2020) |>
  summarise(
    allocated_ksu = sum(standardised_allocated_ksu, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(source_period) |>
  
  # Smallest first, largest last
  arrange(allocated_ksu, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  
  mutate(
    ymin = lag(cumsum(allocated_ksu), default = 0),
    ymax = cumsum(allocated_ksu)
  ) |>
  
  ungroup() |>
  
  # Numeric position for each year
  mutate(
    year_id = as.numeric(factor(
      source_period,
      levels = unique(for_allocation$source_period)
    ))
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(for_stacked) +

  geom_rect(
    aes(
      xmin = year_id - 0.4,
      xmax = year_id + 0.4,
      ymin = ymin,
      ymax = ymax,
      fill = for_standard_2020
    ),
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(unique(for_allocation$source_period)),
    labels = unique(for_allocation$source_period)
  ) +

  scale_fill_viridis_d(
    option = "D",
    end = 0.9
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(
      scale = 1e-3,
      suffix = "K",
      accuracy = 1
    ),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Allocated HPC Compute by Field of Research, 2013/14–2025/26",
    subtitle = "Fields ordered from smallest at the bottom to largest at the top within each year",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Allocated compute (kSU)",
    fill = "Field of Research",
    caption = "Historical hour-based values use an interim 500 core-hours per kSU conversion assumption."
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 17
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 11,
      colour = "grey30"
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 9,
      colour = "grey40",
      hjust = 0
    )
  )
```

```{r}
ncmas_raw <- read_excel(
  here(
    "assets",
    "data",
    "data clean",
    "ncmas_data.xlsx"
  )
)
```

```{r}
ncmas_for <- ncmas_raw |>
  separate_rows(for_as_reported, sep = "\n") |>
  mutate(
    for_as_reported = str_trim(for_as_reported)
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(for_as_reported),
    for_as_reported != ""
  )
```

```{r}
ncmas_for <- ncmas_for |>
  mutate(
    for_code = str_extract(for_as_reported, "^\\d{6}"),
    
    for_percentage = str_extract(
      for_as_reported,
      "\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?(?=%)"
    ) |>
      as.numeric(),
    
    for_name = for_as_reported |>
      str_remove("^\\d{6}\\s*") |>
      str_remove("\\s*:\\s*\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?%\\s*$") |>
      str_trim()
  )
```

```{r}
ncmas_for <- ncmas_for |>
  mutate(
    for_division_code = str_sub(for_code, 1, 2),
    
    for_classification = case_when(
      year <= 2022 ~ "ANZSRC 2008",
      year >= 2023 ~ "ANZSRC 2020",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

```{r}
ncmas_for <- ncmas_for |>
  mutate(
    field_of_research = case_when(
      
      # ANZSRC 2008
      for_division_code == "01" ~ "Mathematical sciences",
      for_division_code == "02" ~ "Physical sciences",
      for_division_code == "03" ~ "Chemical sciences",
      for_division_code == "04" ~ "Earth sciences",
      for_division_code == "05" ~ "Environmental sciences",
      for_division_code == "06" ~ "Biological sciences",
      for_division_code == "07" ~ "Agricultural, veterinary and food sciences",
      for_division_code == "08" ~ "Information and computing sciences",
      for_division_code == "09" ~ "Engineering",
      
      # 10 = Technology — no clean direct 2020 division
      for_division_code == "10" ~ "Others",
      
      for_division_code == "11" ~ "Biomedical and health sciences",
      for_division_code == "12" ~ "Built environment and design",
      for_division_code == "13" ~ "Education",
      for_division_code == "14" ~ "Economics",
      for_division_code == "15" ~ "Commerce, management, tourism and services",
      for_division_code == "16" ~ "Human society",
      for_division_code == "17" ~ "Psychology",
      for_division_code == "18" ~ "Law and legal studies",
      for_division_code == "19" ~ "Creative arts and writing",
      for_division_code == "20" ~ "Language, communication and culture",
      for_division_code == "21" ~ "History, heritage and archaeology",
      for_division_code == "22" ~ "Philosophy and religious studies",
      
      # ANZSRC 2020
      for_division_code == "30" ~ "Agricultural, veterinary and food sciences",
      for_division_code == "31" ~ "Biological sciences",
      for_division_code == "32" ~ "Biomedical and health sciences",
      for_division_code == "33" ~ "Built environment and design",
      for_division_code == "34" ~ "Chemical sciences",
      for_division_code == "35" ~ "Commerce, management, tourism and services",
      for_division_code == "36" ~ "Creative arts and writing",
      for_division_code == "37" ~ "Earth sciences",
      for_division_code == "38" ~ "Economics",
      for_division_code == "39" ~ "Education",
      for_division_code == "40" ~ "Engineering",
      for_division_code == "41" ~ "Environmental sciences",
      for_division_code == "42" ~ "Biomedical and health sciences",
      for_division_code == "43" ~ "History, heritage and archaeology",
      for_division_code == "44" ~ "Human society",
      
      # No direct old equivalent
      for_division_code == "45" ~ "Others",
      
      for_division_code == "46" ~ "Information and computing sciences",
      for_division_code == "47" ~ "Language, communication and culture",
      for_division_code == "48" ~ "Law and legal studies",
      for_division_code == "49" ~ "Mathematical sciences",
      for_division_code == "50" ~ "Philosophy and religious studies",
      for_division_code == "51" ~ "Physical sciences",
      for_division_code == "52" ~ "Psychology",
      
      TRUE ~ "Others"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
ncmas_for <- ncmas_for |>
  mutate(
    allocated_compute_for = allocated_compute *
      (for_percentage / 100)
  )
```

```{r}
ncmas_for |>
  group_by(
    year,
    project_id,
    facility,
    allocated_compute
  ) |>
  summarise(
    for_total_pct = sum(for_percentage, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(
    abs(for_total_pct - 100) > 0.1
  )
```

```{r}
ncmas_for |>
  filter(
    year == 2021,
    project_id == "NCMAS-2021-53"
  ) |>
  select(
    project_id,
    facility,
    for_as_reported,
    for_code,
    for_percentage,
    allocated_compute
  )
```

```{r}
ncmas_for <- ncmas_for |>
  group_by(year, project_id, facility, allocated_compute) |>
  mutate(
    for_total_pct = sum(for_percentage, na.rm = TRUE),
    for_pct_status = case_when(
      abs(for_total_pct - 100) <= 0.1 ~ "Valid",
      for_total_pct > 100.1 ~ "Exceeds 100%",
      for_total_pct < 99.9 ~ "Below 100%"
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
ncmas_for <- ncmas_for |>
  mutate(
    allocated_compute_for = case_when(
      for_pct_status == "Valid" ~
        allocated_compute * for_percentage / 100,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
```

```{r}
for_summary <- ncmas_for |>
  filter(for_pct_status == "Valid") |>
  group_by(field_of_research) |>
  summarise(
    allocated_ksu = sum(allocated_compute_for, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(allocated_ksu))
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  for_summary,
  aes(
    x = allocated_ksu,
    y = reorder(field_of_research, allocated_ksu)
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(
      scale = 1e-3,
      suffix = "K"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "NCMAS Compute Allocation by Field of Research",
    subtitle = "Total project-level allocation across 2021–2026",
    x = "Allocated compute (kSU)",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "FoR allocations are based on reported project FoR percentages. Records with invalid FoR percentages are excluded."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r}
for_year <- ncmas_for |>
  filter(for_pct_status == "Valid") |>
  group_by(year, field_of_research) |>
  summarise(
    allocated_ksu = sum(allocated_compute_for, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
top_fields <- for_year |>
  group_by(field_of_research) |>
  summarise(
    total_ksu = sum(allocated_ksu),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  slice_max(total_ksu, n = 6) |>
  pull(field_of_research)
```

```{r}
for_year |>
  filter(field_of_research %in% top_fields) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = year,
      y = allocated_ksu,
      colour = field_of_research,
      linetype = field_of_research
    )
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 2021:2026
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(
      scale = 1e-3,
      suffix = "K"
    )
  ) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d() +
  labs(
    title = "NCMAS Compute Allocation by Major Field of Research",
    subtitle = "Six largest FoR categories across 2021–2026",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Allocated compute (kSU)",
    colour = "Field of Research",
    linetype = "Field of Research"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```


```{r}
ggplot(

) +
```
```{r}
  geom_col(
```

```{r}
    data = year_totals,
    aes(
      x = factor(year),
      y = total_ksu,
      label = scales::label_number(
        scale = 1e-3,
        suffix = "K",
        accuracy = 1
      )(total_ksu)
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = -0.6,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(
      scale = 1e-3,
      suffix = "K"
    ),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.10))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "NCMAS Compute Allocation by Field of Research",
    subtitle = "Detailed project-level allocation, 2021–2026",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Allocated compute (kSU)",
    fill = "Field of Research",
    caption = paste(
      "Based on project-level reported FoR percentages.",
      "NCMAS-2021-53 is excluded from the FoR breakdown because",
      "its reported FoR percentages total 150%."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 16
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 11
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 10
    ),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 9,
      colour = "grey40",
      hjust = 0
    )
  )
```

```{r}
for_historical <- for_allocation |>
  filter(
    source_period %in% c(
      "2013/14", "2014/15", "2015/16", "2016/17",
      "2017/18", "2018/19", "2019/20", "2020/21"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    historical_for = case_when(
      str_detect(
        research_field_reported,
        regex("Earth.*Environmental", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "Earth & Environmental Sciences",
      
      str_detect(
        research_field_reported,
        regex("Earth|Geoscience", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "Earth Sciences",
      
      str_detect(
        research_field_reported,
        regex("Engineering.*Technology", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "Engineering & Technology",
      
      str_detect(
        research_field_reported,
        regex("^Engineering", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "Engineering",
      
      str_detect(
        research_field_reported,
        regex("Physical", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "Physical Sciences",
      
      str_detect(
        research_field_reported,
        regex("Chemical", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "Chemical Sciences",
      
      str_detect(
        research_field_reported,
        regex("Biological", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "Biological Sciences",
      
      str_detect(
        research_field_reported,
        regex("Information|Computing", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "Information & Computing Sciences",
      
      str_detect(
        research_field_reported,
        regex("Mathematical", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "Mathematical Sciences",
      
      str_detect(
        research_field_reported,
        regex("Medical|Health", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "Medical & Health Sciences",
      
      str_detect(
        research_field_reported,
        regex("Agricultural|Veterinary", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "Agricultural & Veterinary Sciences",
      
      str_detect(
        research_field_reported,
        regex("Other|Unclassified|Unreported", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "Other / Unreported",
      
      TRUE ~ research_field_reported
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(source_period, historical_for) |>
  summarise(
    allocated_ksu = sum(
      standardised_allocated_ksu,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
historical_totals <- for_historical |>
  group_by(source_period) |>
  summarise(
    total_ksu = sum(allocated_ksu),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```
